visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A golden-brown, clear tea liquid is poured vigorously into a white paper cup that features vibrant colorful illustrations of a cartoon cat and pink bears; the background consists of a metallic, industrial stainless steel kitchen counter with small ventilation holes. (2) Dry, dark-colored tea leaves are poured from a gold foil packet into a clean stainless steel container, followed by a sequence showing the leaves steeping in hot, swirling water inside a professional brewing machine with a metal filter. (3) A completed cup of iced golden tea is held steady against an outdoor urban backdrop; the person's hands, wearing blue gloves in some frames, hold the cup which prominently displays the '十口茶' brand logo and cat mascot. (4) Various food toppings are meticulously added to different cups of tea, including a star-shaped yellow pudding being dropped into milk tea and a large white block of almond tofu being placed into a dark reddish tea base. (5) A cube of grey sesame milk jelly is gently added to a cup of creamy tea, followed by a final wide shot showing the storefront of '十口茶' which features a modern wooden facade, a service window, and a staff member.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins speaking with a friendly, energetic, and professional tone over a mid-tempo acoustic pop background music track featuring bright guitar strumming and a light drum kit beat; the distinct acoustic sound of liquid pouring into a paper cup is prominent. (2) As the speaker discusses the high quality of the tea brewing process, the sound of dry leaves rustling is followed by the splashing sound of water hitting a surface, with the music maintaining a steady, uplifting major-key melody throughout the phase. (3) The vocal delivery remains clear and well-paced as the narrator lists various dessert toppings; intentional sound effects of jellies and puddings being dropped into the liquid provide rhythmic punctuation alongside the ongoing acoustic guitar and piano layers in the mix. (4) A mechanical whirring sound accompanies the visual mention of a specific 'whirling' tea processing technique, while the narrator's vocal arousal remains high and positive, conveying a strong sense of enthusiasm for the product's unique taste and aromatic quality. (5) The audio track concludes with the narrator providing the shop's specific address and a standard social media sign-off phrase; the background music slightly ducks in volume during the speech before a clean final fade-out at the very end of the recording.
